snippet.title: Mercury Rising II Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Download here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3021510694
If you're already subscribed, you may need to resubscribe for the update to download.

A sequel to Mercury Rising is finally out! Enjoy even more cut and custom content brought back to life in a highly polished unique experience! There are many things to find in this Halo CE mod, so don't forget to explore!

Mercury Rising features a soundtrack made by cheechas, he released his debut EP alongside this mod so check it out! More music coming very soon!
https://cheechas.bandcamp.com/
https://soundcloud.com/cheechas
http://open.spotify.com/artist/6ZueSymLhBwYx5uOBTb6TM

Creating mods like this takes a ton of time and effort. If you like my work, please consider supporting me! https://ko-fi.com/altis
